title: Bullseye Axe Throwing

services.name: Axe throwing
services.desc: Your group chat has finally agreed on a date. Now comes the harder part: choosing an outing that does more than leave everyone sitting around a table, checking their phones. If you are wondering how to plan group axe throwing, the good news is that it is far easier than organising a complicated night out - and far more memorable once the first axe sticks. Axe throwing works because everyone gets involved. Your most competitive mate gets a scoreboard, the first-timer gets a coach and a target to conquer, and the rest of the group gets plenty to cheer about. With a little planning, your birthday, work social or weekend catch-up can feel like a proper event rather than another round of drinks.

blurb: Bullseye Axe Throwing uses wood tree trunks, not plywood, to give you the best Axe Throwing Experience! Birthday Parties - Corporate Events - Leagues. The best axe throwing experience in Barrie and Newmarket.

quotes.author: Michael Boylan
quotes.text: Initially I came for the axe throwing, but in the end it’s the friends that were formed that kept me coming back!
